text: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1133512' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
